goal: Expose typed Hermes runtime status for dashboard and submit-time bridge decisions without pretending unwired adapters can execute.

acceptance_criteria.description: RuntimeRegistry reports typed status for claude_cli, codex_cli, gemini_cli, hermes_agent, adapter_wired execution readiness, disabled Hermes env, unknown runtimes, and dashboard payload serialization.

HermesBridge exposes the runtime registry, rejects unknown or disabled runtimes with typed reasons, and rejects status-known but unwired adapters with adapter_not_wired before creating background tasks.
